name: terminus-ending
notes: Campaign safety: the alien victory as the player meets it. Notices are shown as in a real play ("notices": true), each with a screenshot. The terminus is forced to 0.745 so the 75% milestone is announced at the next month, then to 0.995 so it completes a month later: the end-of-campaign popup appears and closing it ends the campaign (credits, main menu). The run ends with 'campaign-ended' when the game has left the campaign.
info: [(e['t'], e['ev'], round(e.get('after', 0), 3)) for e in events('terminus')]
[(e['t'], e['headline'], e['endGame']) for e in events('terminus-notice')]
